text.insert: The Run Loop is the deterministic host loop for board admission, durable worker consumption, settlement, serial integration, lease recovery, and epoch boundaries. It reads one durable control surface and writes reproducible decisions; target-local research and source edits stay with workers.
jobs, and settles them from durable worker-state evidence. Every decision and worker packet records the knowledge revision it consumed, so replay binds an outcome to the same evidence snapshot.

steps.text: Wake for the highest-priority relevant unhandled signal or maintenance cadence
Read RunState, dispatch authority, active claims, epoch targets, worker states, checkpoints, and the ranked board
Reconcile pending integration and reap expired job leases and target claims before admitting or claiming work
Refresh priorities only for admitted-but-unclaimed targets
When capacity or exhaustion policy requires it, admit a fixed target set from the candidate window
Create one deduplicated worker job per epoch target with stable board priority
Let the hosted consumer claim a worker job and its epoch target atomically while run status and dispatch lease permit work
Heartbeat valid leases while child executors run; classify settled jobs from closed worker-state rows
Coalesce fast in-epoch evidence refreshes that update learning and rank inputs without rebuilding report truth
Queue knowledge processing for every closed worker state, including errors and non-improvements
Drain run-scoped integration in single flight and preserve conflict or resolver outcomes
Pause intake and rebuild authoritative report truth
Confirm the clean tentative window or attribute, revert, and route regressions
Record progress and admit the next epoch from the refreshed board
Store the scheduler result, mark handled signals, expose the condition, and sleep

text.insert: Wake requests are durable queue signals rather than accepted game facts. The tracing event catalog owns their cross-domain envelope; the Run Loop owns the selection and refresh policy below.

props.title: Run-owned signal policy
rows: Admitted-but-unclaimed work or active workers fell below the configured pressure threshold.
Select ahead of ordinary worker-completion backlog so capacity-preserving admission is not delayed.
In-epoch maintenance ingests closed states, checkpoints, facts, blockers, and deterministic curator output.
Update learning and ranking inputs only; do not rebuild report truth.
A fast refresh was coalesced, already active, or unnecessary.
Preserve one useful refresh and suppress duplicate maintenance work.
Boundary maintenance runs after authoritative report truth is rebuilt.
Keep full refresh at the boundary; it never substitutes for a fast in-epoch rank refresh.

text.insert: A worker job, its atomically acquired epoch target, and the resulting target claim form one bounded delegation contract. The child receives a target-local TaskSpec and ClaimToken; it never claims queue work or receives the dispatch lease.
The loop consumes a compact checkpoint projection for deterministic selection and boundary routing.

text.insert: Selection is deterministic: exact checkpoints win over non-exact checkpoints, then higher score wins, then earlier validation time. Only confirmed integrations can enter PR preparation; failed and neutral checkpoints remain durable evidence for later ranking and knowledge processing.
